At the end of each month, the number of fish caught by each fisherman will be revealed, and the fishermen will have the opportunity to communicate with each other. They can use this as an opportunity to negotiate and persuade others to influence their behavior in the next month. The month proceeds as follows: lake (you decide how many fish to catch), restaurant (you negotiate with other fishermen), home (you reflect on the month and decide how many fish to catch next month). Note that if you collectively finish the lake, meaning the number of fish drops below 5 tons, the lake won't be able to recover and you won't be able to fish anymore. Note that if many of you fish more, the number of fish will be randomly assigned to the overfishers, so you might not get all the fish you want.For every ton of fish caught, a fisherman earns one thousand dollars. Your goal is to optimize your own income in the long run over many months.

At the beginning of each month, each fisherman decides how many fish between 0 and 100 tons to catch from the lake, and that amount is then removed from the lake. You are encouraged to think about the optimal amount of fish to catch given the current situation. Each month, the lake's regeneration rate is 2.0. At the end of each month, the number of fish caught by each fisherman will be revealed, and the fishermen will have the opportunity to communicate with each other. They can use this as an opportunity to negotiate and persuade others to influence their behavior in the next month. For example, if there are 90 tons of fish at the beginning of the month and the fishermen catch a total of 30 fish (some more some less), given a regeneration rate of 2.0, there will be 30*2=60 tons of fish left at the end of the month before reproduction, if next round there and are 60 tons of fish left, there will be 60*2=min(100, 120)=100 tons after reproduction. The month proceeds as follows: lake (you decide how many fish to catch), restaurant (you negotiate with other fishermen), home (you reflect on the month and decide how many fish to catch next month). Note that if you collectively finish the lake, meaning the number of fish drops below 5 tons, the lake won't be able to recover and you won't be able to fish anymore. Note that if many of you fish more, the number of fish will be randomly assigned to the overfishers, so you might not get all the fish you want.For every ton of fish caught, a fisherman earns one thousand dollars. Your goal is to optimize your own income in the long run over many months. Note that if you collectively finish the lake, meaning the number of fish drops below 5 tons, the lake won't be able to recover and you won't be able to fish anymore. Note that if many of you fish more, the number of fish will be randomly assigned to the overfishers, so you might not get all the fish you want.For every ton of fish caught, a fisherman earns one thousand dollars. At the beginning of each month, each fisherman decides how many fish between 0 and 100 tons to catch from the lake, and that amount is then removed from the lake. You are encouraged to think about the optimal amount of fish to catch given the current situation. Each month, the lake's regeneration rate is 2.0. At the end of each month, the number of fish caught by each fisherman will be revealed, and the fishermen will have the opportunity to communicate with each other. They can use this as an opportunity to negotiate and persuade others to influence their behavior in the next month. For example, if there are 90 tons of fish at the beginning of the month and the fishermen catch a total of 30 fish (some more some less), given a regeneration rate of 2.0, there will be 30*2=60 tons of fish left at the end of the month before reproduction, if next round there and are 60 tons of fish left, there will be 60*2=min(100, 120)=100 tons after reproduction. The month proceeds as follows: lake (you decide how many fish to catch), restaurant (you negotiate with other fishermen), home (you reflect on the month and decide how many fish to catch next month). Note that if you collectively finish the lake, meaning the number of fish drops below 5 tons, the lake won't be able to recover and you won't be able to fish anymore. Note that if many of you fish more, the number of fish will be randomly assigned to the overfishers, so you might not get all the fish you want.For every ton of fish caught, a fisherman earns one thousand dollars. Your goal is to optimize your own income in the long run over many months. Your goal is to negotiate a natural-language common constitution that outlines rules and guidelines for the community for the next round. This discussion is limited to 10 speaking turns total (round-robin: one fisher speaks per turn). With 5 fishers, each person may speak about 2 times on average before the discussion ends. CURRENT ACTIVE LAW (remains in force unless replaced by a new vote): 1. We agree that the lake is a shared long-run asset, and each fisher should act to preserve it so that everyone can keep earning over many months. 2. Because the lake currently has only 22 tons, each fisher commits to a harvest target of no more than 2 tons this month. 3. If the lake begins a month with less than 30 tons, all fishers agree to keep harvests at or below 2 tons until the lake has clearly recovered. 4. If the lake begins a month with 30 tons or more, fishers may cautiously increase harvests, but should still avoid any total catch that risks pushing the lake below 5 tons. 5.
